channel.title: Korvexis Therapeutics Newsroom
channel.description: Press releases from Korvexis Therapeutics (fictional company, portfolio demonstration).

item.title: Korvexis Receives FDA Fast Track Designation for BN-101 in HER2-Low Metastatic Breast Cancer
item.description: The designation follows Phase 1 safety and preliminary activity data and is intended to support an efficient path through the remaining stages of development.

item.title: Korvexis Doses First Patient in Phase 1 Study of BN-204 for Vasquez–Trent Syndrome
item.description: BN-204 is Korvexis' first program to apply the Thalorix platform to RNA-based silencing therapy, targeting an ultra-rare inherited hepatic disorder.

item.title: FDA Grants Orphan Drug Designation to BN-204 for Vasquez–Trent Syndrome
item.description: The designation recognizes BN-204 as a candidate therapy for a rare disease affecting a small patient population with no approved disease-modifying treatment.

item.title: Korvexis' First Infectious Disease Program, BN-450, Clears FDA IND Review
item.description: BN-450 adapts the Thalorix lipid nanoparticle platform, originally built for oncology, to mRNA vaccine delivery — the company's first program outside oncology and rare disease.

item.title: Korvexis Initiates Phase 2 Study of BN-101 in HER2-Low Metastatic Breast Cancer
item.description: The Phase 2 study follows a Phase 1 program that showed a materially improved cardiac safety margin relative to the unencapsulated chemotherapy.

item.title: Korvexis Receives EMA Scientific Advice on BN-204 Development Plan
item.description: The advice supports Korvexis' plan for a future European regulatory filing for BN-204 in Vasquez–Trent Syndrome.

item.title: Korvexis Announces $85 Million Series C Financing to Advance Thalorix Pipeline
item.description: The financing will fund the ongoing BN-101 Phase 2 study, continued enrollment in BN-204, and IND-enabling work for BN-310.
